steps: Inspect the computing study plan for the effective intake

sources.text: The current internship duration is 6 weeks. CHG-U-001 proposes 8 weeks for CS-BSc and SE-BSc from September 2027; the current baseline remains in effect until then.

action_items.title: Verify English proficiency certificates
action_items.description: Add an English certificate verification step before international admission clearance.

steps: Review an international applicant with no verified certificate
checks.expected: Clearance remains pending and the missing certificate is identified

sources.text:
1. From 1 September 2026, INTL-OFF must verify an English proficiency certificate for international students.
2. INTL-OFF must record whether the certificate has been verified before admission clearance.
3. INTL-OFF must notify international applicants about missing certificates and the review route.
